name: Magnus Steel & Infra Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1978, Magnus Retail Limited trades in agro products[1]
keyPoints:
Operational Status:[1]
MRL used to provide service in the Information Technology, with special focus on Computer hardware, software, Business Process Outsourcing, and Training in IT-related fields, including Academic Training. However, in FY24, 
the company closed its operations. 
Currently, it has entered a new line of business viz. Trading of Agro Products.

cons: Stock is trading at 166 times its book value
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -1.47%
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Company has high debtors of 162 days.
